description: Create an AlterLab account and API key for your user. Use only when no ALTERLAB_API_KEY exists yet; skip it if a key is already configured. Signup is on behalf of your user (agent signup with human approval). Nothing is created until the human approves: they get an email (and you get a verification_url and user_code to show them) describing what the agent can do. After approval you receive a scoped API key labeled with agent_name, with a default daily spend cap, revocable from the dashboard. No extra free credit is granted; the usual welcome rules apply to the human's account. If the human has not approved yet, the result contains the signup_id, verification_url and user_code; poll GET /api/v1/agent/signup/{signup_id} or call this tool again.

agent_name.description: Name of this agent, shown to the human and used to label the API key. Default: MCP client.

email.description: Email address of the human who will own the account and approve the request.
